mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 2% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6%, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY decline > 2% and UNRATE > 6% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if the rate hike cycle is recent.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a sudden collapse in consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 5% MoM but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and industrial production (INDPRO) is flat or declining, it signals a broad slowdown in economic activity that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and INDPRO flat or declining
failure_condition: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and INDPRO flat or declining but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.
